author: hpux
body:
Hello all!

To celebrate the recent update, as well as Easter, the Event Committee will be hosting a Plug DJ party tomorrow,(https://plug.dj/avicus),Sunday April 5th at 3:30 PM EST!

⊰ Rules ⊱
1. Please follow the General Etiquette and Behavior section on the Avicus Network Rules located here - http://avicus.net/rules
2. DO NOT meh (Down vote) every song. 
3. Nothing inappropriate (Blood, gore, violence) 
4. Max length is 10 mins
5. No impersonation 

Any questions, concerns or suggestions? Feel free to post below. See you there! o/
